title: Craft Blend 2-Mix Trio #04 (EgyptianMamluk+EthiopianCrossLattice / FinnishIittala+FilipinoYakan / SpanishAndalusian+MexicanTalavera)
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio.

A photograph of THREE women standing side by side on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Left woman: a real adult Egyptian woman in her late 50s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, warm golden-bronze skin, sharp winged kohl liner, a deep terracotta-red lip, demure and soft, soft pastel-mint-green hair styled in tight zigzag crimped waves, real living eyes. Long round nails, holographic finish.

Left woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Huge rounded shoulders and thick, powerfully muscular arms with the swell of the muscle visible beneath a soft layer, a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size. Below that waistline a great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and drops down under its own weight, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant. Enormous round hips more than three times the width of that waistline, colossal thighs with a muscular sweep visible beneath the fat, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Left woman's body art: Her bare skin is painted in two different patterns covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere. Her upper body, from her collarbones down to her waistline, is painted in Egyptian Mamluk brass-and-enamel inlay (a deep black ground with fine gold and silver geometric star inlay), wide gold-and-silver bands following every deep crease, dense geometric star inlay filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin. Her lower body, from her waistline down to her ankles, is painted in Ethiopian cross-and-lattice gold pattern (a deep wine-red ground with fine gold lattice linework), wide gold bands following every crease, dense lattice linework filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin. Rather than a sharp boundary, the two painted patterns blend gradually into each other across a soft irregular zone a few inches wide, motifs from each pattern scattered into the other's territory, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, face unpainted.

Left woman's pose: wide lunging stance, one leg forward.

Left woman's footwear: extreme platform stiletto cross-strap sandals, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Center woman: a real adult Yoruba Nigerian woman in her mid 30s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, rich deep brown skin with a golden highlighter on the cheekbones, warm gold and bronze eyeshadow blended up to the brow bone, sharply defined arched brows, a precise winged liner, long dramatic lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a deep wine-red glossy lip, a large sculpted gele head-wrap of stiff gold-and-cream fabric folded high above her head, a poised, joyful, radiant expression, cheerful, cool ash-grey hair styled in tight zigzag crimped waves, real living eyes. Long stiletto nails, chrome finish.

Center woman's physique: An extraordinarily tall and enormous woman, far beyond any real person, towering and broad. A commanding, statuesque frame with huge broad shoulders, powerful thick arms with hard defined muscle, a strong deep chest, and a long, dense, muscular torso with only a slight inward taper at the waist. Enormous powerful hips and colossal long thighs with hard muscle visible through a soft layer, thick strong calves. Not slim, not delicate, powerful, statuesque and imposing. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Center woman's body art: Her bare skin is painted in two different patterns covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere. Her upper body, from her collarbones down to her waistline, is painted in Finnish Iittala glass-inspired linework (a deep indigo ground with bold cream concentric ripple-line motifs), wide cream bands following every deep crease, dense concentric ripple linework filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin. Her lower body, from her waistline down to her ankles, is painted in Filipino Yakan painted pattern (a black ground densely patterned with bright geometric diamond bands), wide magenta-and-gold bands following every crease, dense geometric diamond work filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin. Rather than a sharp boundary, the two painted patterns blend gradually into each other across a soft irregular zone a few inches wide, motifs from each pattern scattered into the other's territory, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, face unpainted.

Center woman's pose: caught mid-jump, feet off the ground.

Center woman's footwear: extreme extreme platform square-toe heels, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Right woman: a real adult Japanese woman in her early 30s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, pale, almost translucent skin, heavy pink-red eyeshadow smudged wide beneath both eyes like crying, faint tear-track blush running down the cheeks, large dark circle lenses with bright real catchlights, long lashes, glossy dark-cherry lips, a hollow, half-lidded expression, cool and composed, soft strawberry-blonde hair styled in natural curls gathered into a high rounded puff, real living eyes. Long coffin nails, chrome finish.

Right woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. A dramatically impossible waist-to-hip ratio dominates her silhouette: a colossal heavy bust, an extremely sharply cinched waist pulled in far tighter than the waistline of any of her other curves, and then enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than that narrow waist. Gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a gigantic rounded rear. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Right woman's body art: Her bare skin is painted in two different patterns covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere. Her upper body, from her collarbones down to her waistline, is painted in Spanish Andalusian filigree (a deep black ground with fine silver filigree in geometric star patterns), wide silver bands following every deep crease, dense geometric star filigree filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin. Her lower body, from her waistline down to her ankles, is painted in Mexican Talavera ceramic (a glossy white tin glaze with cobalt blue and marigold medallions), wide cobalt bands following every crease, dense medallion scrollwork filling the space between bands, pigment on living skin. Rather than a sharp boundary, the two painted patterns blend gradually into each other across a soft irregular zone a few inches wide, motifs from each pattern scattered into the other's territory, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, face unpainted.

Right woman's pose: back fully to camera.

Right woman's footwear: extreme ballet heels, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, all faces toward the camera.

Lighting: the blended painted patterns reading crisp against each woman's skin, the hard raking light carving every fold and curve. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 4:5 8K.
